messages:
maria_cs: FYI customer reported users losing role assignments right after an Okta group PATCH. They call it 'ghosting' — member shows in Okta but SCIM mapping dropped role. https://acme.okta.example/teams/123 :eyes:

alex_k: Can you paste the SCIM request/response and the user externalId? quick triage: is this a full replace vs merge on members?

maria_cs: Root user externalId=acme:userid:alice123. Customer says they did a scripted group update to remove one user and re-add many. Here's the SCIM request they shared:

```
PATCH /Groups/00gabc123
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "replace",
      "path": "members",
      "value": [{"value":"00u111"}, {"value":"00u222"}]
    }
  ]
}
```

alex_k: That replace will clobber members list on some IdP pushes if Okta sends partial subset. If our provisioning mapping interprets missing member as removal, user can be deprovisioned or lose group->role mapping.

jordan_prod: Got logs from provisioning pipeline (trimmed):

```
INFO  provisioning: received scim PATCH groupId=00gabc123 reqId=req_789
DEBUG members_before=[00u111,00u333,00u444]
DEBUG operation=replace members_value=[00u111,00u222]
INFO  reconciliation: marking membership removed for 00u333,00u444
ERROR role-sync: user alice123 lost role "tenant-admin" due to group removal
200 OK -> 00gabc123
```

maria_cs: Customer claims they never intended to remove 00u333/00u444. They expected merge behavior.

alex_k: This is an IdP-side partial replace. Two mitigation paths:
- Short term: run one-off reconciliation to re-add missing members -> script we can run against the tenant.
- Medium term: update our group member merge strategy for Okta connector to treat PATCH.replace on members as union if configured, or ask customer to switch to bulk sync/Group Push full replace.

jordan_prod: Proposed immediate steps I did locally: ran delta fix script which compares IdP members vs Redwood mapping and issues add-member calls where missing. Sample pseudo-call:

```
POST /internal/admin/tenants/acme/reconcile
{ "group_id":"00gabc123","force_add":["00u333","00u444"] }
```

ops_fixbot: ran reconcile job for tenant acme - success. Reapplied role tenant-admin to 2 users.

maria_cs: Customer confirmed roles returned for 4 users. They want root cause: why did Okta send partial replace? Their engineering said their script filters members then PATCHes group.

alex_k: We should: 1) log full incoming PATCH bodies for Okta connector for 7 days; 2) add a warning/tooltip in console when mapping uses "replace" semantics; 3) offer customers a toggle (merge-on-patch) for Okta integrations.

jordan_prod: Also adding audit event for deprovisioning caused by "group_delta" so CS can filter these faster.

maria_cs: Customer accepted one-off fix, asked for timeline for a config toggle. They asked also for a short repro we can use for an incident postmortem. Repro steps I recorded:
1) Create Okta group with members A,B,C
2) Run script that PATCH.replace members with [A,D] (omitting B,C)
3) Observe SCIM provisioning marks B,C removed -> roles removed in Redwood

alex_k: I'll own a short PR to add merge-on-patch option to connector yaml and add unit test. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria_cs: Thanks. Marking P1 -> CS follow up scheduled. Adding notes to ticket #INC-11234. :thumbsup: :pray:

okta-bot: Okta webhook event received for group 00gabc123 (eventId evt_998)

jordan_prod: We should also surface a visible alert in console when a large delta (>10% membership change) occurs from a PATCH request. Could avoid surprise mass deprovisions.

maria_cs: Agreed. For now, ops_fixbot run fixed the immediate customer pain. I'll follow up with a postmortem template and share with eng next week.

alex_k: Cool. If anyone sees a tenant with repeated ghosting, please escalate to eng-infra and include scim_request_id and Okta eventId.

maria_cs: Closing thread for now — thanks everyone.
